name: Caves of Koilos
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add {W} or {B}. This land deals 1 damage to you.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Add {W} or {B}. This land deals 1 damage to you.

needs.what: let a mana ability carry one non-mana rider effect -- here the land dealing 1 damage to its controller -- alongside the mana it makes. `_mana_options`/`_sum_mana` must keep deriving produced-mana tuples from the `add_mana` part alone and ignore the rider, while activation during cost payment still applies the rider without using the stack.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `_sum_mana` in cards/loader.py rejects any effect that is not `add_mana` inside a mana ability, so `damage` cannot sit in this ability. Dropping `is_mana_ability` to smuggle it in makes the card wrong rather than incomplete: a non-mana ability uses the stack and cannot be offered inside cost payment, so the land could never be tapped to help cast a spell. `pay_life` is not a substitute -- it is life payment, not damage from a source, so it is unaffected by prevention, lifelink or `dealt_damage` triggers. Established on Battlefield Forge; this card is the same ability with different colours.
